message: Fern silently drops enum value "active" from the generated SDK: its name "active" matches the name "Active" of the earlier value "Active" when compared case-insensitively. Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.

Fern silently drops enum value "ACTIVE" from the generated SDK: its name "ACTIVE" matches the name "Active" of the earlier value "Active" when compared case-insensitively. Give each value a unique name with x-fern-enum.
